corrections.old_text: ቱ ይህ ነው ፡ ገI ያለውን ያመ
corrections.corrected_text: ቱ ይህ ነው ፡ ገና ያለውን ያመ
corrections.reason: The second character of 'ገና' ('ና') was misread as a Latin 'I' due to a light horizontal top bar; both the image and Andemta phrase ('ገና ያለውን ያመጣዋል') confirm 'ገና'.
Slight ink bleed at the bottom of the right leg of 'በ' caused it to be misread as 'ቢ'; the standard Andemta technical term for supplying an implied word is 'በቃል አምጣ'.
